skill.name: ai-image-generation
skill.description: Use the inference.sh belt CLI to generate, edit, upscale, and stitch AI images with GPT-Image-2, FLUX, Gemini, Grok, Seedream, Reve, and related models.
skill.summary: Generate, edit, upscale, and stitch AI images through the inference.sh belt CLI.
skill.author: halt-catch-fire

security_audit.summary: The skill is legitimate image-generation documentation, but it relies on an authenticated external CLI and remote model providers. Several static command hits are confirmed for actual belt or npx commands, while many Markdown table and fence hits are false positives. No prompt injection attempt was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.suggestion: Replace Bash(belt *) with the narrowest supported command patterns, such as specific app run and app store operations.

remediation.issue: External service handling of prompts and image URLs
remediation.suggestion: Warn users before sending confidential prompts, private image URLs, or unreleased assets to remote model providers.
Ask users to review package and skill sources before running npx skills add commands from the documentation.

remediation.issue: Remote Markdown image and install links
remediation.suggestion: Prefer locally packaged marketplace assets and stable documentation pages where possible.

semantic_findings.description: The skill frontmatter allows Bash(belt *), which permits any belt subcommand under the authenticated CLI. This can exceed the specific image-generation commands shown in the instructions.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The allowed-tools declaration is explicit and uses a wildcard for the belt CLI. The impact depends on belt account permissions, so confidence is high but not absolute.

content.user_title: Create AI Images With CLI Models
content.value_statement: Image teams need quick access to many generation and editing models. This skill provides practical belt CLI commands for image creation, editing, upscaling, and stitching.
actual_capabilities: Lists image generation and editing apps available through the inference.sh CLI.
Provides belt commands for OpenAI, FLUX, Google, xAI, ByteDance, and fal.ai image apps.
Shows image editing, upscaling, and stitching examples using prompt and image URL inputs.
Documents model IDs, model strengths, and common visual tasks.
Links to related image, video, avatar, and background removal skills.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh belt CLI, login, and a working external service account.
Prompts and image URLs may be sent to third-party model providers.
Model availability, pricing, output quality, and rate limits can change.
The skill does not validate content safety or copyright suitability.

use_cases.title: Draft Product Visuals
use_cases.description: Create product photo concepts, mockups, and lifestyle images before a full design or photo production cycle.

use_cases.title: Prepare Campaign Graphics
use_cases.description: Generate social media, poster, and advertising concepts with different models and aspect ratios.

use_cases.title: Prototype Image Workflows
use_cases.description: Test model commands for generation, editing, upscaling, and stitching inside an AI coding workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Basic Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the AI image generation skill to create a product photo concept for a ceramic mug on a clean studio background.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Model for a Goal
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend the best model from this skill for a poster with accurate text, then provide the belt command I should run.

prompt_templates.title: Edit an Existing Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to modify an existing product image URL by changing the background to a warm sunset beach scene.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Multi-Step Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a workflow that generates three campaign concepts, selects one for editing, upscales it, and stitches variants for review.

output_examples.input: Create a professional sneaker product image with studio lighting.
output_examples.output: The assistant selects a suitable image model, prepares a belt command, and explains the expected output file or result link.

output_examples.input: Change the background of an existing product image to a beach at sunset.
output_examples.output: The assistant suggests an image editing model, asks for the image URL if needed, and prepares a safe external-service command.

output_examples.input: Upscale a generated image for a marketing review.
output_examples.output: The assistant uses the upscaling example, notes that the image URL leaves the local environment, and provides the next command.

best_practices: Review prompts and image URLs before sending them to external model providers.
Start with a low-cost or fast model before requesting high-resolution outputs.
Confirm model availability and pricing in the inference.sh account before batch work.
anti_patterns: Do not send confidential images, unreleased designs, or private URLs without approval.
Do not run copied install commands without reviewing the package and skill source.
Do not assume a generated image is legally usable without separate rights review.

faq.question: Does this skill generate images locally?
faq.answer: No. It uses the inference.sh belt CLI to call external image models.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Do I need an account?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples require the belt CLI and login to an inference.sh account.

faq.question: Can it edit existing images?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes examples for image editing, upscaling, and stitching.

faq.question: Are prompts and image URLs private?
faq.answer: They may be sent to external services. Review provider terms before using sensitive content.

faq.question: Does the skill choose the cheapest model?
faq.answer: No. It lists options, but users should verify pricing and limits before running commands.
